mapper.insert: INSERT INTO NURI2_NRMSG_DATA ( MSG_KEY , MSG_STATE , INPUT_DATE , RES_DATE , ALT_COUNTRY_CODE , PHONE , CALLBACK , MSG_TYPE_1 , CONTENTS_TYPE_1 , ALT_SENDER_KEY , ALT_TEMPLATE_CODE , ALT_JSON , MSG_TYPE_2 , CONTENTS_TYPE_2 , XMS_SUBJECT , XMS_TEXT ) VALUES( MSG_KEY_SERIAL.NEXT_VALUE , 1 , now() , now() , '82' , #{phone} , '15222431' , 'ALT' , 'ALT' , #{altSenderKey} , #{altTemplateCode} , #{altJson} , 'MMS' , 'LMS' , '' , #{xmsText} );
mapper.select: SELECT crypto_dec('normal',OS.PHONE_NUMBER,'',0) AS PHONE_NUM, COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_CNT FROM OP_ORDER_ITEM OOI JOIN op_seller OS ON OOI.SELLER_ID = OS.SELLER_ID WHERE OOI.ORDER_STATUS = 10 AND OOI.CANCEL_FLAG = 'N' AND OOI.DELIVERY_TYPE = '2' AND OS.STATUS_CODE = '2' AND OOI.CREATED_DATE > CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(ADDDATE(NOW(), INTERVAL -1 DAY), '%Y%m%d'),'000000') GROUP BY OOI.SELLER_ID ORDER BY count(*) DESC;
